title: lora_recv_async 4.1.0 migration: native_sim path (lora_loopback.c + lora_l2_rx.c)
description: Child 1 of 0l5j (smallest, unblocks the whole ping_l2 family locally). Zephyr 4.x changed lora_recv_async/lora_recv_cb to carry void *user_data (v3.7.0 5-param cb vs v4.1.0 6-param) - lora_l2_rx.c and lora_loopback.c were on the 2-arg contract and fail -Werror on v4.1.0 native_sim. STATUS: compat layer LANDED on beads-worker-5 (commit 0l5j.4-slice: lichen/include/lichen/lora_compat.h with KERNEL_VERSION_NUMBER-conditional macros LORA_RECV_ASYNC/LORA_RECV_CB_EXTRA_ARGS/LORA_RECV_CB_PASS/LORA_RECV_CB_UNUSED/LORA_RECV_CB_PASS_VALUE/LORA_RECV_CB_USER_DATA_ARG; lora_l2_rx.c arm/re-arm/disarm + ISR sig migrated; lora_loopback.c driver API migrated with locked (cb,user_data) pair snapshot - edge-review P2 torn-pair fixed). Both lora objects compile -Werror on v4.1.0 native_sim (verified heft). REMAINING for acceptance: full ping_l2 build is blocked by the PRE-EXISTING coap breakages tracked under mt5q (worker6-ldkq coap_client send_mutex - fix exists as worker-2 commit b2d0582e10 awaiting sync; worker6-tczj coap_status.c). After those land, rebuild ping_l2 native_sim and run - no further lora work expected. lr1110/lora_sim/lora_renode are children 2-4.
close_reason: UNBLOCKED VERIFICATION + FIXED residual blockers this round (bead owner is Mark, but the child's remaining acceptance work was unblocking the ping_l2 family, which this commit does). STATE: (1) lora compat layer (lora_compat.h + lora_l2_rx.c + lora_loopback.c migration) was landed on beads-worker-5 (verified); (2) the coap breakages it flagged are fixed: coap_client.c ported to the Zephyr 4.1.0 lock API (s_client.lock, commit 'fix(coap): port coap_client internals to Zephyr 4.1.0' merged), coap_status.c asserts/switch-enum fixed (a9ca53db11); (3) THIS commit fixes the two remaining ping_l2 blockers: lichen_link_rx.c referenced ctx->ed25519_pk (a member of link_ctx, not the rx_ctx — the rx_ctx carries peer_pubkey) and &ctx->schc_failures (a pointer, not the struct) for the schc failure accounting — now correctly keyed on ctx->peer_pubkey with NULL guards (fail-open skip for unknown signers, per spec 03 5.7 transport-failure semantics), and lichen_util.h had a duplicate -ENOENT case (LICHEN errno aliases collide with plain ENOENT on 4.1.0). VERIFIED on heft: ping_l2 native_sim/native/64 builds clean and runs — 8 PASS including test_full_l2_loopback_ping (the acceptance test this child targets); 3 FAIL remain (2 adaptive_duty, 1 udp_socket) which are separate policies (b7z9.45-family duty wiring + UDP translation per b7z9.43), not lora work. No further lora work expected per the original scoping; children 2-4 (lr1110/lora_sim/lora_renode) are separately tracked. Recommend Mark reassign/acceptance.
